name: com.your.ai.framework
description: A general-purpose Unity framework with LLM-driven AI as an optional module. The base layer is fully usable without any API key; the AI layer is an add-on, never a prerequisite.

samples.description: 16 self-contained demos, one per module: module center, event bus, pools, save, procedure flow, data tables, assets, localization, UI panels, audio, entities, networking, SDK hub, diagnostics, hot-update and AI. Zero asset dependencies - import, add DemosHub to any scene, press Play.
One request, one streaming response, printed to the console.
A UI Toolkit chat window over AgentViewBehaviour and AgentViewModel, with streaming text, phase display and a failure banner.
